issue_context.title: autocompletion / suggestion for # (reverence issues/pulls)
issue_context.body:
rev: https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/Community/issues/472 & #3611

open menue to choose issue/pull numbers from by typing the title like you can do on github ...

review_comments: I think we can support both `#123` and `<owner>/<repo>#123` at the same PR. Looks like Github doesn't support `<owner>/<repo>#123` yet.
And we should also support both `#<keyword>` and `#<digitals>`, if it's `<digitals>`, parse as int64 and get the issue directly. And it should be the first one on the returned results.

- `<owner>/<repo>#123` would require the user to enter the correct repo name already, thereby I assume most users would simply copy the complete to the issue of that other repo.
- For `#<digitals` I don't think this is helpful as you would need to know the issue id already to search for it, so you could directly write it, right 😅  

As both options could be easily added later on, I would skip adding them for now.

> I think we can support both `#123` and `<owner>/<repo>#123` at the same PR. Looks like Github doesn't support `<owner>/<repo>#123` yet.

I do not think it makes sense, what is the real use case to find some issues by crossing repositories?

(I also agree adding `#<digitals>` to the top is convenient while it is better to have but not a must in this PR)
